fullSheets.name: Rules and Scoring
rows: Please check discord for uptodate info - Late League - Please check discord for uptodate info
Late League is essentially ranked Grifball customs!  You sign up individually and will go up and down the leaderboard based on a win/loss LP system.

When you first sign up for Late League, your first 3 games will be your placement games.  These matches are used to build your initial player grade. This player grade will influence how you progress through the ranks.

Each win you will receive 1 Rank (50 MMR)
Each loss will cause no effect

In the PlayGrifball Community Discord, a host will announce signups in the Late League (Ranked Customs) channel, sign up using the bot command and you're in!  The bot will create teams and update the leaderboard, all you need to do it go to your designated team and play!

Basic Scoring:
1 Win = +25 LP (League Points)
1 Loss = -15 LP

Win Streaks: Bonus LP
3 Game win streak = +25 LP
6 Game win streak = +50 LP

Loss Streaks: LP Penalty
3 Game loss streak = -25 LP 
6 Game loss streak = -50 LP

The leaderboard is split up into divisions and tiers.  Each division has 3 tiers and each tier requires 100LP in order to progress.

Division Ranking: Each division has 3 tiers.
Challenger
Masters
Diamond
Platinum
Gold
Silver
Bronze

Once you reach 100LP in a tier, you will tier up. You will start at 0LP in the new tier.

If you are at 0LP, you will drop a tier once you go below 0LP in your current division.

Discord Bot Functionality: The bot will handle sign-ups, lobby generation, & stat updating.

Team Generation Balance: Using player stats & win/loss in conjuction with MMR, teams will be better balanced to allow for increased fairness.

End of Season Rewards: Once you've achieved a certain rank or accomplished a certain task, you willbe entitled to a reward based on what you've achieved. Said rewards may be trophies, miniatures, or trinkets, all Grifball/Halo related.

While bot is running do not edit Lobby/Waitlist cells. Any other cell can be edited
1. Choose game version with &game halo3/haloreach/halo4/halo5
2. Begin signup period with &open
3. Once 8 players are in bot will auto make lobbies. If it needs to be remade use &r1 or &r2
4. Player's vote on the correct winner.
5. Upload the most recent game stat XML file to the stat bot. XML location is %USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\MCC\Temporary
6. Lobby will be regenerated after voting completes.
7. If a player is gone or a wait lister is gone, use &remove DISCORDUSER to take them out of the list. If a player is afk but still going to play, use &drop DISCORDUSER to move them to the bottom of the list.
8. Close signup period at end of night with &close

Suspension Tier:
First Offence - Warning "based on viewed behavior by Late League host"
First Offence - 3 session/day
Second Offence - 5 Session/day
Third Offence - Permenant Ban

What to expect:
After a player has broken the rules, they will receive a suspension as follows in the tier list. The time in which the suspension is applied may vary. An announcement will be made when a suspension occurs, with the weekly pinned message being updated accordingly.

Verbal Abuse - it is your responsibility as a player to use the tools available at your disposal to handle this. This entails muting & blocking communications. If verbal abuse persists beyond this, where they circumvent your mute/block & go out of there way for continued harassment, then we shall step in.

Examples of Infractions:
Warning Issued - "Mavbrid makes a mistake and Nihilus gets mad. Nihilus betrays Mavbrid off spawn, BUT proceeds to stay at spawn to catch Mavbrid once again. He proceeds to betray him 2 more times." 

Reasoning - Maintaining a competitive environment is paramount to us. In this example, due to multiple betrayals, Nihilus interrupted game play thus incurring a warning.

Suspension Issued - "ASpence bonks MysticalNovice off spawn. MysticalNovice proceeds to betray ASpence twice afterwards as retaliation. They both act in a trolling manner with each other for a portion of the game. MysticalNovice then begins to strategically betray ASpence twice in the last round of the game. After the match ends, MysticalNovice attempts to provoke ASpence into lashing out via chat."

Reasoning - In this example, the combination of provoking post-game & betraying to negatively impact game play, lead to a suspension issued. It is important to denote in this example, MysticalNovice attempted to provoke ASpence post-game. This is a clear demonstration of toxic behavior in combination with in-game negative activity.

How to Report:
1. Player uses report function on bot. (Not currently available)
2. Player contacts Late League hosts with issue.
3. Player records clip of issue in question and supplies it to Late League hosts.
Purposely AFK to allow opponent to win
Afk to type, costing game. Afk for first round score.

fullSheets.name: Patch Log
rows:
Visual
    Bot visuals have been drastically improved. You will now see better visual organization for each command that corresponds to player information output.

- Removed rank and stats commands. Replaced with profile command. 
- New profile section displays your Rank, Grifbux, stats for the currently selected game.
- Colored bar in profile correlates to the player's current rank.
- Updated post game information display. Now shows both teams with each player's current rank and LP.

Lobby & Match Functionality
    The lobby system & win input system have been enhanced. Generation of a lobby will be faster and more precise than before. Additionally the ability to determine the hosting type has been added. These newer features are a step in the right direction to ultimately allow players to run their own lobbies.

- Bot will now create a lobby once 8 players have signed up.
- Addition of a command to select host type. Dedicated host positioned in Central is on by default.
- Addition of a voting system for players to determine the winning team. Votes are completed through selecting the corresponding emote for Red or Blue teams.
- On court host selection randomly selects a player from the lobby. Selected host will have a higher weighting applied to team generation. This will help balance teams more efficiently.

Base Rank Progression
    Standard rank progression has changed to work in tandem with the new placement & balancing system. In order to match the new speeds at which players will progress, the current numbers had to be swapped up.

- LP gains for wins reduced to 25 per win. Down from 30 per win.
- LP gains for losses reduced to -15 per loss. Down from 21 per loss.
- LP gains for 3 win streak increased to 25. Up from 10.
- LP gains for 6 win streak increased to 50. Up from 16.
- LP gains for 3 loss streak increased to -25. Up from -12.
- LP gains for 6 loss streak increased to -50. Up from -18.

Placements & Player Balancing
    Placements have been changed to handle the new rank progression. Instead of 5 matches to determine your starting position, you will have 3 matches to build your starting player grade. As you continue to play, your player grade will become more accurate, narrowing down your progression until you’ve reached the system desired rank. 

- Removed amateur & pro monikers.
- Placement match total reduced to 3 games. Down from 5.
- Placement MMR gains per win remain the same. MMR gains per loss remain the same.
- Accelerated LP gain system implemented based on player grade. Each grade has an MMR ranking correlated to it. Example acceleration:

            S Grade Player will receive
            300 LP (3 ranks) per win in Bronze.
            200 LP (2 ranks) per win in Silver.
            100 LP (1 rank) per win in Gold.
            50 LP per win in Platinum.
            25 LP (base gains) per win in Diamond.

Grifbux
    Means of earning Grifbux have been introduced through Late League. For every win you receive & every time you neutral host a match, you will receive 20 Grifbux. The bot will now keep track of all Grifbux earned, with a means to identify your current total via the profile command. As of now, every Sunday will be the payout period.

- Addition of Grifbux. Players receive 20 per win & 20 per neutral hosting.
- Profile command displays current Grifbux total.
- Grifbux are paid out every sunday.
- Grifbux total is purged on payout.
- All Grifbux earnings are retroactive.

Hotfix
- Reduced lobby generation loop timer down to 3 seconds. Down from 30 seconds
- Added a que for remove commands when a match is in session. Removes will initiate once stats have been written.

Hotfix
- Halo 4 medals have been added for stat tracking. Medals from previous matches are not retroactively added. This may change in the future.

Introduction of Season Lengths
        Late League will now have better organization & transparency with how seasons work. Each game will have a set season length by the number of hosted days. This allows for players to have a clear understanding of how many days they can effectively play.

- All Halo’s start with 30 session season length. Sessions are defined by a hosted day. 
- Seasons may increase in session length as seen fit.

Mid-End of Season Tournaments
        In order to improve competitiveness in a season, we’re introducing mid and end of season tournaments. More information will be give on this at a later date.

Visual
- Profile page now displays if a player has not played in the current season.
- Waitlist now displays estimated wait time for each player. First few sessions may display incorrect times. Estimated time will increase in accuracy for following sessions.
- Lobby now shows the remaining season length.

Lobby & Match Functionality
- Europe has been removed as an option for neutral & oncourt host.

Player Bot Command
In order to help facilitate automation, new commands have been added to the bot functionality. Likewise discord username handling has been improved.

- Bot will now handle discord user names with @USERNAME. 
- &kick @discordusername in order to start a vote kick. 5 votes are required to kick a player from the lobby.
- &drop will now allow players to drop themselves to the bottom of the wait-list.
- &board command added. &leaderboard removed.
- &board will now display the top 5 players for each Halo.
- &board halo4 | halo5 | haloreach | halo3 will display the top 15 players for the chosen game.

New Game Addition
        It’s about time to have a new game thrown in the mix. Halo 5 has been added in to help give those with the itch a chance to play competitively with others in the community.

- Halo 5 has been fully implemented into the bot & google sheet.
- Stat collection is fully automated from the Halo API
- Lobby generation times are longer than standard due to API response times.

Base Rank Progression
        In order to help maintain a healthy state of progression for players, LP adjustments have been made to make it happen.

- All LP from losses adjusted from original base of -15
- LP gains for losses reduced to -10 in Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum 3
- LP gains for losses reduced to -15 in Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum 2
- LP gains for losses reduced to -20 in Bronze/Silver/Gold/Platinum 1
- LP gains for losses reduced to -10 in Diamond 3
- LP gains for losses reduced to -20 in Diamond 2
- LP gains for losses increased to -30 in Diamond 1
- LP gains for losses reduced to -15 in Masters 3
- LP gains for losses increased to -30 in Masters 2
- LP gains for losses increased to -50 in Masters 1

Player Grade Adjustments
- Halo 4 has received 3 new player grades; Playmaking, Defence, Stops per Minute.
- Halo 4 weightings have been adjusted.

Hotfix
- Lobby-info channels are now temporary channels created for the session. Only players within the lobby can see the channel.
- Team voice channels are now temporary channels created for the session. Only player of the correct team can see their channel.
- Added match-history channel to display all post game information. 
- Bot now automoves users into their respective team channels when lobby is generated. Players will be moved back into the main lobby after a match's voting concludes.

Bot Updates
        - Addition of leaderboard channel. Updates after each session to the latest top 15 players.
        - Addition of queue channel. Updates in real time when players join, drop, & remove themselves.
        - Removal of voting for winner
        - Addition of &list command to show you current signup list.
        
Lobby Changes
        - Removal of voting for winner
        - Addition of XML uploading in Lobby Info channel. Bot determines winner through XML.
        - Additon of XML authenticity verification.
        - Addition of emote voting for changing Lobby host & restarting Lobby.

Lobby Function
        - Addition of a buffer to prevent lobbies from closing when a player leaves the lobby. 
        - Addition of quick post game information.
        - Updated command information in Lobby Info
        - Addition of High Stakes matches. Every 5th match will be High Stakes. 
           -High Stakes creates unbalanced teams with one being the favored to win. The favored team receives reduced LP for a win & loses substantial LP for a loss. Opposite applies for non-favored team.
        
Base Rank Progression
        - Addition of Iron rank. MMR will be 0-50.
        - Streak bonuses changed from +25,50,75,100 reduced to +15,30,45,60

Bot Function
       - Bot will now auto open signups at 8pm EST
       - Bot will now auto close signups at 3am EST if there are 4 players or less signed up.

Lobby Function
        - Added drop down functionality for voting for host type & to restart the lobby.
        - Added drop down functionality for vote kicking.
